arguments.sql: SELECT 1.0 * COUNT(f.transaction_id) / COUNT(*) AS labelled_fraction FROM transactions t LEFT JOIN fraud_labels f ON f.transaction_id = CAST(t.id AS TEXT)
arguments.explanation: Returns the share of all transactions that have a row in fraud_labels, as a fraction between 0 and 1.
assumptions: 'All transactions' means every row in the transactions table, labelled or not, over the full range 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31.
A transaction counts as labelled if it has any row in fraud_labels, whatever its is_fraud value.
